fact_check.note: True for the four pharmacies checked, but not checked against Walgreens at 615 S Meadow St (#19370, 607-272-6290), Walmart pharmacy or Cayuga Employee Pharmacy. Walgreens 615 S Meadow is not in the article; its hours page timed out. State the claim as 'among the pharmacies we checked'.

fact_check.claim: TCAT: no route numbers listed (could not open TCAT schedules)
fact_check.note: TCAT returned HTTP 403 for me too. The article is honest, but the bus-access promise of the angle is unmet.

beats_top.why: The #1 result is a thin aggregator listing with no usable hours, so our page already beats it on the Cornell Health pharmacy, but the planned angle (hours for each pharmacy and bus access from campus) is only half delivered. CVS has no hours or phone, the other Walgreens (615 S Meadow St) is missing, and the transit section gives a student nothing actionable.
changes: Fill the CVS row with hours and phone from a source that loads, or drop the row
Add real bus guidance: which TCAT routes reach Wegmans / Pine Tree Rd / W Clinton St with a link, or a clear walking-and-ride estimate
Say upfront whether Cornell Health can fill a prescription written by an outside doctor (e-scribe rule) because that is the most practical transfer question

fixes: Replace the sentence 'You do not need a Cornell Health clinician to fill a prescription from another doctor.' with the sourced rule from https://health.cornell.edu/services/pharmacy: prescriptions from non-Cornell providers within New York State must be e-scribed to the pharmacy (listed as 'Cornell - zip code 14853' in Surescripts); out-of-state prescriptions can be dropped off, phoned in, faxed to 607-254-5042 or e-scribed.
In the Parking bullet remove 'under the building'. The source says only '10 paid spaces reserved for Cornell Health patients' at $3/hour plus a $0.35 transaction fee.

Remove 'including refrigerated ones' and 'Staff notify you through myCornellHealth' from the mail-order bullet, and remove 'Upload your pharmacy card in myCornellHealth' from the insurance bullet, unless you can quote them from https://health.cornell.edu/services/pharmacy. Keep the 110 Ho Plaza Level 4 address, Window 3 and ID.

In transfer step 3, remove the claim that moving a prescription in requires a clinician appointment unless the page text supports it. Keep only the ADHD documentation line. Add the page's advice to call 607-255-5155 at least 3 business days before your last dose when you need a renewal.

Fill the CVS row (625 W Clinton St) with pharmacy hours and phone from a source that loads (the CVS page shows neither; phone may be 607-273-3647 per a directory, which must be confirmed from CVS or the row marked unconfirmed). If the hours cannot be sourced, delete the row and the 'not confirmed' text.

Add the second Walgreens, 615 S Meadow St (store 19370), with hours and phone from https://www.walgreens.com or remove nothing and say the page lists only the ones checked. Change the 'Nothing we found keeps a pharmacy counter open past 9 PM' and 'None that we found' lines to 'Among the pharmacies we checked'.

Rewrite the 'Getting there without a car' section: find route numbers and stops from a TCAT page that loads (try https://tcatbus.com/ route pages or Google Transit / the Cornell Transportation page https://fcs.cornell.edu/departments/transportation-mail-services) and name the routes that serve Wegmans and Pine Tree Rd, with a link. If this cannot be sourced, say plainly that no TCAT route has been verified and give the walking time from Ho Plaza to the pharmacy instead; do not leave the bus question open.
